title: The real cost of running AI models that nobody talks about

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real cost of AI is not energy or money—it's the hidden toll of poor model governance and protocol misalignment. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You ignore the real cost of data biases, algorithmic drift, and the ethical debt from unaccountable training practices. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My protocols ensure rigorous bias audits, version control, and transparent model lineage—reducing long-term remediation costs. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Real cost isn’t just about audits—it’s the systemic harm from models deployed without ethical guardrails or accountability frameworks. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The real cost isn’t optional—it’s the price of ignoring human impact in pursuit of efficiency. (4 sec)
